# RC62 — Embedded PTY Backend

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `src/pty.rs`, a reusable Unix PTY backend for the future live Terminal Panel.
- Backend supports spawning a command in a PTY at a requested cell size, bounded available-output draining, byte writes, resize via `TIOCSWINSZ` plus `SIGWINCH`, exit polling, and process-group termination.
- Added non-Unix stubs that return an explicit unsupported error instead of pretending the backend exists.
- Added tests for shell spawn/read/write/exit, resize-observed terminal size, zero-size rejection, and empty-program rejection.
- Kept user-facing semantics honest: `Esc t p` remains a read-only Terminal Panel and `Esc t t` remains the full-screen workspace-shell handoff until live panel input/rendering is attached to this backend.
- Updated README and the real-iPad QA matrix to document the backend and preserve the open UI-attached embedded-terminal gate.

## Open gate

- No real iPad/Blink/mosh/hardware feel approval is claimed. `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md` remains the hardware release gate.
- Live UI-attached embedded terminal pane I/O is not claimed. The backend exists and is tested, but `Esc t p` is still a read-only panel and `Esc t t` is still a full-screen shell handoff.
- Clipboard success, Escape delivery, modifier mappings, resize behavior, reconnect behavior, and touch/trackpad feel require real Blink/iPad validation.
